description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage AI company as a Founding Engineer building autonomous agents for complex computer-based work. You will own core systems that help agents execute reliably over extended periods, learn from accumulated knowledge, and demonstrate performance against human-level benchmarks.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build agents that pursue goals over weeks with minimal or no human intervention.

 - Design memory systems that help agents retain and use knowledge to improve over time.

 - Develop evaluation frameworks to determine whether agents outperform people on specific tasks.

 - Improve agent reliability and reduce the need for human review of individual runs.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Hands-on experience building production agents that people rely on, with a clear understanding of their failure modes.

 - Experience with agent memory, long-running execution, multi-step reasoning, and maintaining goal coherence over time.

 - A track record of building evaluation systems that inform real decisions, including comparisons against human-level baselines.

 - At least 1 to 2 years at a fast-growing or AI-focused startup, and evidence of substantive engineering work.

 - Published research that others build on, or software shipped at meaningful scale.

 - Strong engineering fundamentals and evidence of exceptional problem-solving, such as competitive programming, founding experience, or an equivalent credential.

 - Agent architecture experience is a plus. A collaborative, kind approach to working through challenging problems is valued.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

$200,000 to $300,000 annual base salary, with up to $350,000 for exceptional candidates. Meaningful founding equity is available. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site, five days a week in San Francisco, California, United States.
